name: tempered bronze
unidentified_descriptor: a bronze blade older than it should be
first_pickup_chronicle: Tempered bronze. The old Bronze Age smiths could match much of what later iron-workers achieved — and against constructs, they could exceed it. Stone and metal answer this metal differently.
design_notes: Fills pf 33 gap. Mundane bias (max_enchant 3) — anti-construct/golem bonus. Reforged bronze of a forgotten era.
